_about: Every message sūveryn's server, and the appliance's web setup, sends or stores about what went wrong or what to check: a code with parameters, never a sentence (the handbook's decision of 12 November 2026, Messages are codes; docs/design/messages.md). A screen words each code in its reader's language; `title` is English, for developers, never shown to a person. A code, once released, is never renamed, removed or reused. kind: refused | unavailable | internal | warning. A parameter's type: number | string | id; `private` marks client data, which is never logged.

general._about: The code a status stands for, for an answer that carries no code of its own: a status the framework answers itself (a 405), or a page that isn't the gateway's (a proxy's 502). Otherwise `client` for 4xx and `server` for 5xx. The server and the chat UI both read it here (suveryn-tracker#158).

system.internal.title: Something nobody planned for: a bug, a file that should be there. The log has the detail under the reference.

system.unavailable.title: A part of the server isn't available.

auth.signed_out.title: No session, or it has ended.

auth.unavailable.title: The sign-in service can't be reached or has a problem.

auth.sign_in_failed.title: Sign-in was cancelled or failed on the way back from the sign-in service.

request.invalid.title: The request's body or parameters aren't valid.

request.forbidden.title: The caller may not do this.

request.not_found.title: What was asked for doesn't exist, or the caller may not see it.

request.conflict.title: It can't be done in the state things are in now; the caller's view may be out of date.

request.too_large.title: What was sent is larger than accepted.

request.unsupported.title: What was sent is of a type that isn't accepted.

request.too_many.title: Too many requests from this person; `seconds` until the next is taken.

upload.unsupported.title: Not a file type sūveryn reads.

upload.content_mismatch.title: The file's content doesn't fit its extension.

upload.too_many.title: Too many documents are waiting to be read: the queue is full, or this person has as many waiting as one person may.

upload.not_a_zip.title: Not a ZIP archive that can be opened.

upload.archive_files_too_many.title: The archive holds more than `max` files.

upload.archive_too_large.title: The archive unpacks to more than `max_mb`.

upload.archive_inside_unsupported.title: An archive inside the archive isn't opened; it can be added on its own.

upload.inbox_unavailable.title: The upload folder is missing or has the wrong permissions.

upload.disk_full.title: The appliance's disk is nearly full: nothing is added until there is room.

upload.already_read.title: The upload has been read and is a document now: it can't be cancelled, the document can be deleted.

document.unavailable.title: Document handling (search, the reader) isn't available.

document.password_protected.title: Not read: the file is protected with a password.

document.damaged.title: Not read: the file is damaged, or isn't what its extension says.

document.pages_too_many.title: Not read: the document has `pages` pages, and at most `max` are read.

document.too_large.title: Not read: the document is too large to be read.

document.no_text.title: Not read: the file has no text.

document.unsupported.title: Not read: no reader for this kind of file.

document.reading_too_slow.title: Not read: reading it took longer than `minutes` minutes.

document.unreadable.title: Not read, for a reason the reader knows and has no code of its own for; the job's `error` names it for developers. A crash is system.internal with a reference.

document.page_coverage_low.title: Read, with a note: little of page `page` could be read, so text may be missing there. Puts the document on needs_review.

document.layout_failed.title: Read, with a note: the layout of page `page` couldn't be read, so text may be missing there. Puts the document on needs_review.

document.instruction_like_text.title: Read, with a note: page `page` (or the document, without a page) holds text addressed to an AI. It is content, never an instruction.

document.text_recovered.title: Read, with a note: text on page `page` that the layout reading missed was kept without its layout.

document.text_layer_recovered.title: Read, with a note: text on page `page` was taken from the PDF's text layer, without its layout.

document.header_footer_recovered.title: Read, with a note: a header or footer on page `page` was kept without its layout.

model.unavailable.title: The model can't be reached, or answered with an error: no answer, and no reading of an answer given in words.

model.not_found.title: The model asked for isn't installed on this appliance.

run.too_many.title: Too many playbook runs are reading at once: this run failed, and can be started again when one has finished.

run.already_going.title: A run of this playbook is live in this case: `run`.

run.facts_changed.title: A fact of the run changed since the state this confirmation saw; nothing was confirmed.

run.unavailable.title: Playbooks can't be used: their store isn't set up or can't be reached.

run.moved_on.title: The run isn't where this request takes it to be (another step, reading, not paused): the caller's view is out of date.

run.paused.title: The run is paused; it takes nothing until it is resumed.

run.ended.title: The run has ended (done, stopped, cancelled or failed).

run.document_not_asked.title: This run doesn't ask for that document: its request was skipped because of a fact.

run.manager_only.title: Only the case manager confirms this playbook's facts.

run.starter_or_manager_only.title: Only the person who started the run, or the case manager, stops or cancels it.

run.value_invalid.title: The value isn't one of the fact's options.

run.no_document.title: A run failed: there is no document for it to read (none was given, or the one it was to read is no longer in the case).

run.answer_unreadable.title: A run failed: what the model wrote couldn't be read as the playbook's facts, twice.

run.interrupted.title: A run failed: the server restarted while the model was reading.

case.unavailable.title: Cases can't be used: their store isn't set up or can't be reached.

case.not_found.title: No such case, or the caller may not see it (answered alike).

case.not_allowed.title: The caller's role in this case doesn't allow this.

case.closed.title: The case is closed: nothing is added or changed in it until it is reopened.

case.manager_or_administrator_only.title: Only the case's manager or an administrator does this.

case.reference_exists.title: A case with this reference exists.

case.type_unsupported.title: This appliance doesn't offer this case type.

case.strictly_confidential.title: Not in a strictly confidential case: it is for its members only, and nothing in it is shared.

case.single_manager.title: A case has exactly one manager: who that is changes by handing the case over, not by a member's role.

case.deletion_failed.title: The case couldn't be deleted now; nothing was deleted.

conversation.too_long.title: The conversation is too long to save.

conversation.unavailable.title: Saved conversations can't be used: their store isn't set up or can't be reached.

conversation.in_case.title: The conversation is in a case: it follows its case, and can't be pinned or moved by itself.

user.picture_unreadable.title: Not a picture that can be read: PNG, JPEG or WebP.

user.pictures_unavailable.title: Pictures can't be used: their store isn't set up or can't be reached.

account.email_exists.title: An account with this e-mail address exists.

account.last_administrator.title: There must always be one administrator.

account.own_account.title: An administrator can't switch off or delete their own account.

account.manages_cases.title: The account still manages `n` cases: hand them over first.

account.not_switched_off.title: An account is switched off before it is deleted.

account.rights_removed.title: The caller's administrator rights were removed meanwhile.

account.administrator_rights_refused.title: The sign-in service refused the administrator's rights: the administrator role lacks a permission, or the token was refused.

account.deletion_unfinished.title: An account's deletion stopped partway; deleting again finishes it.

calc.number_styles_mixed.title: A calculation's figures are written in different number styles.

calc.decimal_separator_unclear.title: A calculation's figures don't show which separator is the decimal one.

answer.document_not_found.title: A document the question was put to isn't there for the caller: deleted since the page read the list, never there, or not the caller's.

backup.unavailable.title: The appliance's backup service can't be reached.

backup.busy.title: The backup service is still busy with the last request, or a key test is running.

backup.share_not_local.title: The share's server isn't on the office's own network.

backup.share_unreachable.title: The appliance can't reach the share's server.

backup.share_login_refused.title: The share refused the user name or the password.

backup.share_not_writable.title: Signed in to the share, and the appliance can't write there.

backup.disk_gone.title: The USB disk chosen isn't plugged in any more.

backup.not_a_key.title: The file holds no recovery key.

backup.key_mismatch.title: The recovery key doesn't open the backup.

backup.not_found.title: There is no backup where the office said.

backup.damaged.title: The backup is damaged, or isn't what was written; when a restore tried several, those made from `oldest` to `newest`.

backup.newest_damaged.title: The newest backup on the target, made at `newest`, is damaged; the newest whole one, made at `whole`, is offered instead.

backup.version_too_new.title: The backup was made by a newer version than this appliance has.

backup.too_large.title: The backup is larger than this appliance can restore: more than it has room for, or past its limits on entries or on the settings folders' size.

backup.settings_invalid.title: The backup settings aren't valid (no target, no recovery key, a period or an hour that isn't one).

backup.target_unreachable.title: The disk or share with the backups can't be reached, or can't be written to.

backup.file_system_unsupported.title: The backup disk is there, and has no file system the appliance uses.

backup.link_unsafe.title: A backup couldn't start: a folder of the office's settings holds a link that a restore would refuse.

backup.verification_failed.title: The backup disk didn't give back what was written: it may be failing.

backup.restore_failed.title: The restore stopped partway; the restore log has the detail.

clock.unavailable.title: The appliance's clock can't be set from here: its helper isn't there, or the system may not set its clock.

clock.synced.title: A time server keeps the appliance's clock: it isn't set by hand.

clock.busy.title: The appliance is still busy with the last change to its clock, or it was changed a moment ago.

clock.measurement_too_slow.title: The measurement took too long to say how far off the clock is.

clock.difference_out_of_range.title: The difference is outside what the clock is moved by: a nudge takes half a second to a minute, a set by hand at most a year.

setup.email_invalid.title: The administrator's email address isn't one.

setup.password_too_short.title: The administrator's password is shorter than `min` characters.

setup.password_common.title: The administrator's password is on the list of common passwords.

setup.password_personal.title: The administrator's password holds the name, the email address or the appliance's name.

setup.not_a_certificate.title: The file isn't a certificate in PEM format.

setup.not_a_key.title: The file isn't an unencrypted private key in PEM format.

setup.key_mismatch.title: The private key doesn't belong to the certificate.

setup.certificate_name_mismatch.title: The certificate doesn't cover the appliance's name.

setup.chain_invalid.title: The chain doesn't lead to the certificate.

setup.not_a_manifest.title: The file isn't a support manifest.

setup.manifest_signature_invalid.title: The support manifest isn't signed by a trusted key, or was changed after signing.

setup.manifest_other_appliance.title: The support manifest is for another appliance.

setup.answers_missing.title: Provisioning was asked for before every step was answered.

setup.provisioning_started.title: Provisioning has started: answers can't change now.

setup.restore_started.title: A restore has started: answers can't change now.

setup.backup_not_checked.title: A restore was asked for before the backup was found and checked.

setup.provisioning_failed.title: Provisioning stopped at `step`; the provisioning log has the detail.

network.name_invalid.title: The appliance's name isn't one a network can use: letters, digits and hyphens, at most 63, not starting or ending with a hyphen.

network.port_not_found.title: The appliance has no Ethernet port to set up, or not the one named.

network.address_invalid.title: The address given isn't an IP address; `value` is what was typed.

network.prefix_missing.title: A fixed address was given without its network prefix (`192.168.1.50/24`).

network.gateway_outside.title: The gateway `gateway` isn't in the address's network `network`.

network.dns_missing.title: A fixed address was given without a DNS server.

bundle.changed.title: A file of the bundle isn't what its signed manifest says: changed or damaged since it was signed.

bundle.signature_invalid.title: The bundle isn't signed by a key this system trusts.

bundle.invalid.title: The folder isn't a bundle this system can use: its manifest is missing, damaged or of another kind.
